Compact Utility Performance with Operator Comfort

Built to Work. Engineered for Versatility.

The DK4220SEHB delivers smooth hydrostatic control, strong hydraulic performance for its class, and a comfortable enclosed cab designed for year-round operation. It is well-suited for loader work, mowing, snow removal, and general property maintenance where precision and ease of operation matter.

Features May Include:

Turbocharged Diesel Engine
Efficient 3-cylinder diesel engine designed for dependable torque and fuel efficiency in daily work applications.

Hydrostatic Transmission
Infinitely variable forward and reverse control for easy operation, especially in loader and maneuvering tasks.

Enclosed Cab with HVAC
Factory cab with heating and air conditioning for comfort in all weather conditions.

4WD Capability
Four-wheel drive provides traction in mud, snow, gravel, and uneven terrain.

Loader-Ready Design
Compatible with front-end loaders for lifting, moving, and material handling tasks.

High Ground Clearance
Designed to handle uneven terrain and field conditions with improved clearance.

3-Point Hitch System
Category 1 hitch compatibility for implements such as blades, mowers, and tillers.

Operator Convenience Features
Ergonomic seating, power steering, and easy-access service points for daily usability.
